keyEvents.text: Goal! Getafe 0, Sevilla 1. Kike Salas (Sevilla) header from the centre of the box to the top right corner. Assisted by Félix Correia with a cross following a corner.
Gabriel Suazo (Sevilla) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
Substitution, Sevilla. Manu Bueno replaces Isaac Romero because of an injury.
Substitution, Getafe. Orel Mangala replaces Francho Serrano.
Substitution, Getafe. Davinchi replaces Jean Valou.
Davinchi (Getafe) is shown the yellow card for a bad foul.
